query: select narrative_slug, window_end::date as day, nvd_value, narrative_velocity, evidence_velocity from signal_nvd where topic = %(topic)s and corpus_version = %(corpus)s and window_days = 3 and window_end between '2024-11-15' and '2025-02-05' order by narrative_slug, window_end
note: 3-day NVD for all eight narratives, 2026-04-09 corpus build.
